design_notes: All three people begin in the workshop; the walk, birthday journey and garden ending are omitted. The cup has two reachable designs. Both retain the dent as part of its history, and cooling is represented before handling each firing. Care and Fear weight the design kernels.
mismatches: The source’s home and garden scenes are condensed into a workshop ending.
Smoothing the dent is an alternate outcome rather than the source’s thumb-rest choice.
